# Window Splitter

Window Splitter models quantized values and host-independent range movement.

## Basic usage

Window Splitter demonstrates horizontal as a separate, interactive configuration.

<ComponentExample component="window-splitter" scenario="horizontal" title="Window Splitter" description="Window Splitter demonstrates horizontal as a separate, interactive configuration." :index="0" />

## Features

- Quantized value.
- Step.
- Page step.
- Separator projection.
- Orientation.
- Controlled value.

Each feature is part of the public semantic contract. Host packages may expose different input and rendering helpers while preserving accepted transitions.

## State ownership

State that changes application-owned data supports controlled or uncontrolled ownership where the component contract permits it. Use uncontrolled state for local behavior and controlled state when a parent coordinates validation, persistence, or multiple controls.

## Disabled and readonly

Host projections distinguish disabled interaction from readonly inspection when the underlying control permits both. Disabled controls leave the interaction sequence; readonly controls remain available for inspection while rejecting mutation.

## Semantics

The component contract follows [the relevant accessibility pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/windowsplitter/). Visual styling remains outside the package; use host attributes, parts, and state projections as styling hooks.
